verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents event-driven automation in several forms: Pipelines for building automated workflows, AI-powered workflows triggered from the pipeline, automatic Jira status updates when commits include issue keys, customizable merge checks, and automated change approvals via Jira Service Management. However, the evidence never describes a general user-defined rules engine for event-to-action triggers, and the automation shown is mostly CI/CD-centric or fixed integrations. Missing for 10: an explicit user-configurable event-triggered rules engine, documentation of supported event types and trigger configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
